rows.en:
(Is that... Akimizu over there...?
She and Claire-senpai look like they're
having a great time.)

Hey, Akimizu.
And Claire-senpai too.

Huh?
Oh, \p-kun.
Hello.
What are you two up to?

Just having a little chat,
I suppose you could say?

Claire-senpai has been teaching me
all sorts of things.

...Yuu, it's not 'Senpai'...
It's 'Big Sister', remember?
rows.notes: Claire corrects senpai to o-nee-sama (schoolgirl 'big sister' address). Kinship word translated per brief as 'Big Sister'; 'Onee-sama' would be the alternative if the team prefers romaji here.

rows.en: Y-yes, I'm sorry, Big Sister...

It's all right, Yuu.
Just be careful from now on...
Y-you two sure are close...
Do you think so?
Of course we are!

Say, \p-kun,
do you have any plans after this?
No, nothing in particular...
Then why don't we all go out for tea?

Oh, um, let me see...
What should I do...?
*staaare*
rows.notes: Stare sound effect (jii), shared by many scenes (x15).

rows.en:
(Wh-whoa, she's staring at me like she
really doesn't want me along...)
Hey, Yuu, you think so too, don't you?
Huh? Oh, I, um...

(Now she's staring at me like she
absolutely can't stand the idea...)
rows.notes: Escalation of c00624 (monosugoi -> totetsumonaku iya-sou na me).

rows.en:
Oh, ah, AAAH!
I-I was supposed to hang out with
Yuuto today! Yeah, that's right...
rows.notes: Third JP line 'sou datta sou datta' merged into line 3 to stay within 3 lines; the repetition is reduced to one 'that's right'. Yuuto is written as a fixed name in the script, not the \p code.

rows.en: Oh, is that so?
Then let's hang out another time.
Y-yes!
Well then, goodbye!
See you, \p-kun.

(Akimizu's really attached to
Claire-senpai!)

(That's... Yuu over there!
She and Claire-senpai look like they're
having a great time.)

Yuu! And Claire-senpai too!
What are you two up to?

Huh?
Oh, \p-chan.
Hello, \p-chan.

Say, \p-chan,
do you have any plans after this?

(Wh-whoa, she's giving me
a seriously icy stare...)
*staaaaare*
(That's the iciest stare I've ever seen...)

Oh, ah, AAAH!
I-I was supposed to hang out with
Yui today! Yeah, that's right...
See you, \p-chan.

(Yuu's really attached to
Claire-senpai, huh.)

...Hello,
\p-kun.
Are you heading home now, Senpai?

Hmm... Well, something like that...
What about you?
I'm heading home.
By yourself?

Uh, yes.
Is that a problem?
Oh, no reason at aaall!?
(Is she in a bad mood or something?)

...Say, isn't there something
you need to tell me?

Where's this coming from all of a sudden?
Something to tell you... Not really...
I don't think??

Oh? Playing dumb, are we?
Hmm...
Um...

...I hear you've gotten awfully close
with that woman lately?
I heard the rumors...
rows.notes: 'ano onna': the woman is not identified in the scene; Claire seems to be play-acting a jealous rival (x2: also used elsewhere).

rows.en: Huh??

But I... won't lose...
I'll be the one who laughs last!

...Hello,
\p-chan.
Are you heading home now, Claire-senpai?
I'm on my way home.
Yes... Is that a problem?

What's gotten into you all of a sudden?
Something to tell you... Not really...
I don't think??

uncertain: c00613/c00614: o-nee-sama rendered 'Big Sister' (kinship word translated per brief); 'Onee-sama' is the alternative.
c00628/c00643: three JP lines fitted into three English lines by dropping one repetition of 'sou datta'.
c00658: 'that woman' is never identified; Claire appears to be play-acting a jealous rival.
